about_the_game:
Bitbound is a procedurally generated open‑world survival game that blends the creative freedom of sandbox play with the high‑stakes tension and replayability of roguelikes.

Explore a massive world

Journey across diverse biomes, gather valuable resources, and descend into complex cave systems as you gear up to discover what lies beneath the surface.

Brave the depths

Brave brutal, procedurally generated dungeons packed with hazards, puzzles, and ruthless bosses. Conquer them for high‑risk, high‑reward gear.

Face dangerous foes

Master a skillful combat system to outmaneuver enemies and topple powerful bosses. Loot and craft better equipment to tackle greater threats.

Customize your playstyle

Choose from a wide array of perks, abilities, and weapon types. Build a character that fits melee, ranged, stealth, or hybrid approaches.

Stand your ground

Fortify your base with traps, turrets, and barricades. Upgrade defenses, recruit NPC allies, and adapt your strategy to survive waves of invaders.

Developers Note

Please keep in mind that Bitbound is still in early development. As such, not all content showcased may be included in the final version of the game. Features, mechanics, and visuals may be subject to change prior to launch.

short_description: Explore, craft, and conquer a pixel‑perfect world that’s different every time. Journey into a vast procedurally generated landscape, filled to the brim with dangerous biomes, shifting underground dungeons, rare loot, cunning enemies, and hidden secrets waiting to be unearthed.
